name: game
description: What game, and is it good? Any engine. A design studio: game-ideation, fun-targeting, core-loop, systems-economy, progression-content, level-ux, art-direction, game-brief, prototype-plan, design-diagrams, and one-page-game-design for a one-page visual design as interactive HTML or standalone SVG with a printable PDF, collaborative or headless. A review board backed by cited rules distilled from 38 game-development books: game-studio-cpo as the entry point, and auditors for systems, balance and economy, code architecture, performance, and QA and ship-readiness.
